description: An object tends to remain at its last directly observed location.
An object last associated with a carrier may be at the carrier's later location.
A tool-capable container that left a location after the object plausibly arrived there may have transported the object to its destination.
An ambiguous identification may mean the object was never where the ambiguous track was seen; its last unambiguous location stands.
A low-confidence absence report may be a missed detection; the object may remain at its last observed location, occluded.
An object that vanished while with a carrier may be inside a capable STATIONARY container at one of the carrier's stops — invisible to inspection, revealed only by a scan.
